jobs.title: Now Hiring:Armored Truck Driver And Messenger in Missouri City,TX
jobs.description:
Opportunity in Missouri City

Snapshot

  • Hiring Organization: GardaWorld
  • Position: Armored Truck Driver And Messenger (Flexible/Contract, Missouri City)
  • Based in: Missouri City, TX (a vibrant local hub)
  • This Missouri City-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in relevant skills.
  • Our GardaWorld team in Missouri City, TX is growing.
  • Benefit from working in Missouri City, a key hub for the Security And Financial Logistics industry.

Rewards

  • Salary: $23-$28/Hour (approx. $53.5k/Year)
  • Benefits: A competitive compensation package is offered.
  • Set your own schedule.

What You'll Do

  • Apply your your professional skills skills at our Missouri City location.

About GardaWorld

GardaWorld is a global champion in security services, integrated risk management, and cash solutions. We protect the high-value assets of financial institutions, major retailers, and government agencies worldwide. We offer our employees a robust, highly secure working environment where discipline, integrity, and safety are the highest operational priorities. We pride ourselves on hiring professionals who thrive in high-stakes environments.

A Timeline of Your Daily Operations

  • 6:00 AM - Secure Dispatch: Arrive at the heavily fortified GardaWorld vault facility. You will arm yourself, review the daily manifest with your partner, and conduct a rigorous mechanical and security inspection of the armored commercial vehicle.
  • 7:30 AM - Tactical Routing: Navigate the armored vehicle safely through dense city traffic or suburban routes. You must maintain absolute situational awareness and utilize defensive driving techniques to prevent accidents and mitigate security risks.
  • 10:00 AM - Asset Transfer: Act as the armed messenger. You will exit the vehicle to securely deliver and pick up cash deposits, coins, and valuable assets from retail clients and ATMs, operating with hyper-vigilance while your partner secures the perimeter.
  • 3:00 PM - Vault Reconciliation: Return safely to the branch facility. You will follow strict, heavily audited procedures to transfer the collected assets back into the vault and complete all digital and physical chain-of-custody paperwork.

The Security Advantage

This is a highly structured, rewarding role that combines commercial driving with elite physical security. You will enjoy a predictable daytime schedule. GardaWorld provides a highly competitive hourly wage, comprehensive medical and dental insurance, robust 401(k) options, and all necessary tactical and firearms training.

Qualifications

Must be at least 21 years of age. A valid driver's license with a pristine driving record is required (commercial license preferred but not always mandatory). You must possess or be willing and able to obtain a state-issued armed security guard license and a permit to carry a firearm. A flawless criminal background, exceptional ethical integrity, and the physical ability to lift heavy coin bags (up to 50 lbs) are mandatory.

jobs.title: Security Officer Enhanced Part Time Visitor Processing
jobs.description:
Security Officer Enhanced Part Time Visitor Processing

Overview


Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description


Life doesn’t always follow a fixed schedule. That’s why we created the Security Officer – Part Time Enhanced position: a flexible, dependable option for individuals looking to supplement their income, gain hands-on experience, or work toward a full-time career with the industry leader.

As a Security Officer Enhanced Part Time Visitor Processing in Missouri City, TX, this role is designed to provide reliable, consistent hours at an assigned site with the flexibility for you to earn more by picking-up additional shifts when it works for you.

Pay Rate: $16.33 / Hour

Job Schedule:

Day
Time

Mon
03:00 PM - 07:00 PM

How This Role Works:

  • Fixed-Shift Commitment (“Anchor Shifts”): You will be hired for a designated site and weekly shift that serves as your reliable base schedule. This assignment requires a six (6) month commitment.
  • Earn More, Claim-A-Shift Program: In addition to your fixed shift, you may pick-up extra shifts through our scheduling platform, allowing you to increase earnings and gain experience across multiple sites. Work part-time hours this week and full-time the next. It’s all up to you.

This role is ideal for candidates seeking part-time employment with flexibility, income stability, and opportunities to build-up to a full-time schedule of up to 40 hours per week; always with the option to scale back when needed.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide customer service to clients by carrying out security-related procedures, site-specific policies, and emergency response activities when appropriate at a logistics and distribution location.
  • Monitor and control access points for employees, visitors, contractors, and delivery personnel; verify credentials and maintain accurate visitor and access records.
  • Respond to access-related incidents, alarms, and critical situations in a calm, problem-solving manner, following site-specific escalation procedures.
  • Conduct regular and random patrols of access points, loading areas, parking areas, business operations, and the perimeter to help deter unauthorized activity.
  • Communicate clearly with site personnel, drivers, and Allied Universal leadership regarding access concerns, unusual activity, and incident documentation.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Have at least 2 years of security-related experience.
  • Be at least 21 years of age.
  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us:

  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial Benefits: Participate in our retirement savings plan to invest in your future.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.


Closing


Allied Universal® is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. For more information: www.aus.com.

If you have difficulty using the online system and require an alternate method to apply or require an accommodation, please contact our local Human Resources department. To find an office near you, please visit: www.aus.com/offices.
